day-of-week-finder.quickAnswer: Type any date and instantly learn its weekday - for example, 18 October 2026 is a Sunday, day 291 of the year, in ISO week 42. The tool also tells you whether it is a weekend and how many days away it is from today.
keyFacts: The weekday comes from modular arithmetic: every date is a fixed number of days from a known reference, and the remainder mod 7 gives the weekday.
The Gregorian calendar repeats every 400 years, so weekday patterns cycle on a 400-year rhythm.
ISO weeks start on Monday; week 1 is the week containing the first Thursday of the year.
Day-of-year runs 1 to 365 (366 in leap years) and is handy for serial numbering and spreadsheets.
Weekend here means Saturday or Sunday - some countries observe Friday-Saturday weekends instead.

day-of-week-finder.formula:
Weekday = (days since a known reference date) mod 7.
ISO week: week 1 = the week with the year's first Thursday; weeks start Monday.
Day of year = sum of the days in all earlier months + day of month.
Example: 2026-10-18 -> Sunday, day 291, ISO week 42.
day-of-week-finder.workedExample:
Date: 18 October 2026.
1. Day of year: Jan-Sep total 273 days + 18 = day 291.
2. Weekday: 1 January 2026 was a Thursday; day 291 means 290 days later; 290 mod 7 = 3, so Thursday + 3 = Sunday.
3. ISO week: the Thursday of that week is 15 October (day 288); (288 - 1) / 7 = 41, so week 42.
4. Weekend: Sunday -> yes.
5. Days from today: 0 (it is today).
benefits: Settles 'what day was...' questions for birthdays, anniversaries and history.

limitations: Weekend is defined as Saturday-Sunday; regions with Friday-Saturday weekends should interpret accordingly.
The Gregorian calendar is assumed; dates before its adoption (1582) follow the proleptic Gregorian calendar.
ISO week numbering has edge cases at year boundaries - 1 January can belong to week 52 of the previous year.
Very old dates may render inconsistently across browsers.

faqs.q: How can it know the weekday of a date in 1950?
faqs.a: Calendars are pure math. Counting days from a known reference date and taking the remainder mod 7 gives the weekday for any date, past or future.

faqs.q: What is an ISO week number?
faqs.a: The international week-numbering system: weeks start Monday, and week 1 contains the year's first Thursday. It is standard in Europe for planning and payroll.

faqs.q: Why is 1 January sometimes in week 52?
faqs.a: If 1 January falls on Friday, Saturday or Sunday, it belongs to the last week of the previous ISO year. That is correct ISO behaviour, not a bug.

faqs.q: Does it account for different weekend conventions?
faqs.a: It flags Saturday and Sunday as the weekend. If your country observes Friday-Saturday, treat Friday results accordingly.

faqs.q: What calendar does it use for old dates?
faqs.a: The proleptic Gregorian calendar - the modern rules extended backwards. Dates before October 1582 did not historically use this calendar.

faqs.q: Can I find the weekday of my birthday?
faqs.a: Yes - enter any birthdate. For a full birthday breakdown, try the Birthday Calculator.
